caseName: Friedman v. Court on the Judiciary of New York
caseNameFull: Friedman, Justice, v. Court on the Judiciary of the State of New York
attorneys: Theodore Kiendl and Raphael H. Weissman for appellant., John R. Davison and William R. Brennan for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
